notes: «وَ بِهَذَا الْإِسْنَادِ» takes the names of prev3, the nearest report that writes its chain; prev1 and prev2 open with the same phrase and write none; the names taken over are those before «عَنِ الْحَسَنِ», which the text writes itself
the Imam «أبي عبد الله» follows «عن», so he is a narrator (owner ruling 2)
the closing «قال مصنف هذا الكتاب» is the compiler's comment, not a link
